posts.author: AstroGnome
posts.body:
Even with custom world tiles, the world map feels flat, remember playing an old rpg maker (xp?) game that had cliffs in the world map. The same kinda cliffs that the outside tiles have. they were used to depict mountains ,valleys,  etc.
Wish I could remember the game, but the map was beautiful, instead of the same mountains everywhere, the map had a sense of elevation.
Is there a tile set that adds cliffs to the world map in rpg maker mz?

posts.author: Nirriti
posts.body: Marumugi4510 on Itch.IO did that for its 8BIT tileset... technically as it was meant for FLOATING islands. I repurposed it for land/cliffs (makes things more interesting visually—for cheap comparison, think of SuperMarioWorld. Though in this case, more detailled). Think outside the box! Also, as you said, you can reuse dungeon tiles, if you wish.
